chunks: Concerning semen: if a man is junub and, when he rises, he looks and checks but finds nothing, then there is nothing upon him. But if he did not look and did not check, then he must wash it and repeat his salat (prayer).

key_terms.الْمَنِيِّ: semen, the substance discussed in the ruling of ritual impurity
key_terms.جُنُبًا: in a state of janabah, requiring ghusl due to seminal discharge
key_terms.صَلَاتَهُ: his salat (prayer), which must be repeated in this case
key_terms.نَظَرَ: he looked, meaning he inspected for traces
key_terms.يَغْسِلَهُ: he must wash it, meaning remove the impurity

ai.seo_question: If a junub person suspects semen but did not inspect for it before praying, must he wash and repeat the prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about suspected semen on the body or clothing in relation to salat (prayer). If a junub person checked and found nothing, no obligation remains upon him; but if he failed to check, he must wash it and repeat his salat (prayer).
